description: This PHP class defines an AllowedPermission data transfer object (DTO) used within the OrangeHRM system. It encapsulates permission flags (read, create, update, delete) and provides methods to create instances from an array and to check individual permissions.

classes.name: AllowedPermission
classes.description: A DTO class representing permission flags (read, create, update, delete) with factory method and accessors.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Static factory method to create an AllowedPermission instance from an associative array.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Returns whether read permission is granted.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Returns whether create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Returns whether update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Returns whether delete permission is granted.
